close_reason: Replaced 'for ext in exts.iter()' with 'for ext in exts' in all three extension-scanning loops.
description: check_critical_extensions, has_key_cert_sign, and cert_basic_constraints all use 'for ext in exts.iter()' where exts is already a shared reference to a slice. Clippy::explicit_iter_loop: 'for ext in exts' auto-derefs and is idiomatic. The .iter() call is redundant noise. Three call sites affected.
title: for ext in exts.iter() should be for ext in exts — .iter() is redundant on &[T]
